about: Round 08, 2026-09-24 — setup, the first round on GPT-6 Sol at medium (the app's setting since c21413d; founder: "give me 15 setup questions using medium sol and ill review them"). Every question is a real one from production, in the asker's words, never used in a round before. Fourteen are the founder's own (July–September), asked on his A800RR: run-with-setup-0919 (TFTR, 19 Sep, with its setup), sa-sat-0912 (Radio Racing Cars SA, low grip, the state-titles Saturday, with the LiveRC tool) and private-sa-fri-first-run (SA Friday, tyre run 5). One is a tester's app-starter question on his own run (Robbie's AMX3). Two cases are the real two-turn threads (p-08: 1 Aug; p-09: 19 Sep, asked on the 0919 run itself). One try each: what a driver would see. Run one context at a time: --contexts <context> --only <its ids>.
